# Exact obstruction to the marginal-only Lorentz inference

## The auxiliary claim and its failure

The proposed route used only that each of three variables X_i has density 2x on [0,1]. For weights h=(2,1,1), it would need every joint law to satisfy

    ess sup(2X_1+X_2+X_3) >= 1+sqrt(3).

There is instead an explicitly certified joint law with

    2X_1+X_2+X_3 <= 273/100 < 1+sqrt(3)

almost surely. The strict comparison is exact, since (173/100)^2=29929/10000<3.

## Finite rational construction

The complete finite certificate is `../assets/pk-nov6/computations/beta_coupling_exact_certificate_root.json`. It contains N=200, a list of 399 triples (i,j,k) indexed from 0, and 399 strictly positive rational masses m_(i,j,k). They obey the following identities:

    sum m = 1,
    sum_(j,k) m_(i,j,k) = (2i+1)/N^2,
    sum_(i,k) m_(i,j,k) + sum_(i,j) m_(i,j,k) at index k
        = 2(2j+1)/N^2,
    2(i+1)+(j+1)+(k+1) <= 546

where the third identity means that the combined second and third coordinate marginal at every index r is 2(2r+1)/N^2. Repeated indices count twice. The exact verifier below states this unambiguously.

Choose a triple with its listed mass, then exchange its second and third coordinates with probability 1/2. The resulting three integer indices I_1,I_2,I_3 each have marginal probability (2r+1)/N^2 at r. Conditionally on those indices, choose X_l independently with density

    2x / [((r+1)/N)^2-(r/N)^2]

on [r/N,(r+1)/N] when I_l=r. Mixture gives density 2x on [0,1] for every X_l. The order exchange preserves the weighted support condition because the last two weights coincide. Consequently

    2X_1+X_2+X_3 <= [2(I_1+1)+(I_2+1)+(I_3+1)]/200
                    <= 546/200 = 273/100

almost surely. Thus all continuous marginal and upper-support assertions follow from the finite rational identities.

The initial numerical search was used only to select a finite support. The masses in the saved certificate were solved afresh by exact rational Gaussian elimination. Positivity, all marginal equalities, total mass, and every support inequality are verified in exact arithmetic. The verification does not trust a floating point residual or numerical probability.

## Independent exact verification procedure

`../assets/pk-nov6/computations/verify_beta_coupling_certificate_root.py` reads only the rational JSON certificate, checks its stated positive integer N, parses every mass with Fraction, and asserts the identities above. It neither imports the LP output nor performs optimization. It is a finite check of a fully specified exact construction, not computational evidence for an unspecified existence statement.

The obstruction shows that the concave cap-root sum argument cannot recover the desired generalized Lorentz inequalities solely from the three Beta(2,1) marginal distributions. The actual geometric cap variables may obey additional restrictions; those restrictions must be proved and used separately.
